nodes.name: Requirements Document
nodes.summary: Markdown document "Requirements Document" (specification, 99 lines): SCRUM-178 advances `intake_context.protected-base-capture` from a descriptive read-only catalog node into a typed protected-base evidence boundary. The node must capture the exact protected-base SHA as immutable evidence, support deterministic readback, and reject stale-base or drifted evidence.

nodes.name: Implementation Plan
nodes.summary: Markdown document "Implementation Plan" (specification, 78 lines): Implement SCRUM-178 in dependency order while keeping the change inside the existing `intake_context` family and preserving the current G0-only boundary. The plan should be small enough to review independently and should not introduce a parallel family or broader workflow surface.
